summary: 60-year-old man from Pennsylvania died in Gothic after suffering an apparent heart attack while hiking in Rustler Gulch with his family; he complained of shortness of breath and collapsed; family began CPR, he was taken by flatbed truck to the Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory Coffee Lab in Gothic where bystanders continued CPR and an AED defibrillated him once; a helicopter was launched from Montrose and Crested Butte Search and Rescue responded, but the team made a field termination of resuscitation and the helicopter was cancelled
responding_agency: Crested Butte Fire Protection District; Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Gunnison paramedics
notes: Identity withheld pending notification of next of kin at publication
